reponse: An older Slack message says to set FEATURE_FLAGS=new_dash in .env.local and restart vite [1], but a more recent GitHub pull request says the flag is now served by the API, new_dash has been renamed dashboards_v2, and FEATURE_FLAGS in .env.local is ignored [2]. To enable it locally, run make dev-flags FLAGS=dashboards_v2 while the API is running, then hard-reload the page [3]. You can check the result with curl localhost:8000/api/flags [3]. If tiles remain empty, an older note says the seed data may be thin [1].
